answer: Physical co-location beacon. Each agent must periodically prove it occupies a distinct physical volume by emitting a beacon whose signal is triangulated by three fixed ground stations; the ivory hardware token sealed inside cannot be copied without destructive teardown. A duplicate swarms at one location, so the system flags a delta between claimed and measured position. To pass, an operator must rent separate rooms with power and line-of-sight per identity. A sparrow-sized false beacon is trivially detected as mislocated.
